title: Single affine attachment of a supported perfect map
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subseteq W$ be opens with $W$ quasi-compact, and let $V$ be an affine open. Let $T\subseteq X$ be closed with quasi-compact complement. Use chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$, its localized open sites, $U$, and the localized open sites of $U$, in one Hom universe. Let $E\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_X)$, $R\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\beta:R\to E$. Assume that at every $x\in W$ there is a strictly perfect local model for $R$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] and that every cohomology stalk of $R$ vanishes at every $x\in W\setminus T$. Then there exist $R^\prime\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\beta^\prime:R^\prime\to E$ having these local perfectness and support properties on $W\cup V$, and an isomorphism $e:R^\prime|_U\cong R|_U\oplus(R|_U)[1]$ such that $\beta^\prime|_U=(\beta|_U)\circ\mathrm{pr}_1\circ e$. No property outside $W\cup V$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09IM, proof paragraph assuming a two-open cover with the second open affine, applied on W union V; initial ambient extension by Tag 08BT

proof.text: Set Y = W union V. Apply [lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction] to obtain derived localizations on Y and every localized open site of Y in the ambient Hom universe. Build L: D(X) -> D(Y), H: D(Y) -> D(U) and J: D(X) -> D(U). The unit of Modules.overEquiv Y, the associators and overFunctorMap give L composed with H naturally isomorphic to J; mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso yield the derived comparison c. These are explicit isomorphisms, not chosen existence witnesses.

Apply [lem-sc-supported-map-affine-union-gluing] with the explicit comparison c. Obtain a perfect object F on Y, supported on T intersect Y, a map alpha: F -> E restricted to Y, and an isomorphism e: H(F) -> J(R) plus J(R)[1] with H(alpha) followed by c_E equal to e followed by first projection followed by J(beta). This step stops on Y.

Apply [lem-sc-supported-map-initial-ambient-lift] on Y to F and alpha. Obtain R prime and beta prime on X, the required local perfectness and support on Y, and d: L(R prime) -> F with L(beta prime) = d followed by alpha.

Define the final isomorphism as c_Rprime inverse followed by H(d) followed by e. Naturality of c gives J(beta prime) = c_Rprime inverse followed by H(L(beta prime)) followed by c_E. Substitute the initial ambient lift equation, use functoriality of H and then the union map equation. Associativity identifies the result with the final isomorphism followed by first projection followed by J(beta). This categorical calculation is the fully proved private helper restrict_map_comparison.

theorem exists_supported_map_affine_attachment
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U W V : X.Opens) (hUW : U ≤ W) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X))
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (R : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β : R ⟶ E.obj)
    (hR : (∀ x : X, x ∈ W → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)))
    (hRT : (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ W → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R).val.presheaf x))))
    :
    ∃ (R' : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β' : R' ⟶ E.obj),
      (∀ x : X, x ∈ (W ⊔ V) → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R' ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ (W ⊔ V) → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R').val.presheaf x))) ∧
      ∃ e : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R' ≅
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ⊞
            (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj R)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.map β' =
          e.hom ≫ biprod.fst ≫ ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.map β
